title: The generated record and the checks paragraph went stale after the pass 1 records commit, so make record-check failed
resolution: After the fixes, make verify ran on the clean tree, make record rewrote the generated part, and the checks paragraph names the verified tree and the later commits; make record-check passes.

title: The records did not say that only hosts with GNU Make 4.4 or later catch the regression, while CI runs GNU Make 4.3
resolution: Design D2 and the limitations state it, checked in the pinned ubuntu:24.04 image with GNU Make 4.3; a make doctor check is named as a possible follow-up.

title: The integrate test passed no make shell payload in BRANCH or RESUME, so dropping them from unexport went unnoticed
resolution: BRANCH carries a shell payload that must arrive byte for byte and a RESUME payload must create no marker; both fail when the variable is dropped from unexport under GNU Make 4.4.1.

title: Task 4.1 and the remaining gates still listed review pass 1 as open after it ended without findings
resolution: Task 4.1 is ticked and pass 1 is no longer a remaining gate.

title: The spec delta dropped the change from the generated verification record requirement without saying so
resolution: The requirement names CHANGE's verification.md again within the length limit.
